en.quote: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
en.riddle: and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
en.speaker: David

he.quote: וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים שֹׁעֲרִים וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים מְהַֽלְלִים לַיהוָה בַּכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְהַלֵּֽל
